Halfway down the rocky path to the shore, she spotted it: a dull green bottle sealed with crusted wax, half-buried in wet sand. She pried the cork free, unfolded the yellowed paper inside, and read the looping cursive: “If you find this, tell my sister I never stopped looking for the island we saw as children.” She glanced out at the hazy horizon, tucking the note into her oilskin pocket, and knew she would spend the rest of her shift squinting at every smudge of land on the waves.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还浸在浅灰色的薄雾里，街灯拖着昏黄的光带，把空旷的马路照得像一条安静的河。最早的环卫工握着扫帚划过路面，发出沙沙的轻响；远处24小时便利店的玻璃门透出冷白的光，偶尔有晚归的人裹着外套快步走过，影子被路灯拉得很长。没有早高峰的喧嚷，没有商圈的嘈杂，只有风卷着几片落叶掠过街角，整座城市像还在做一个未醒的梦，等着第一缕阳光把它轻轻唤醒。", "w03": "- Imagine you’re standing in a super long line for ice cream, and you want to know how many people are ahead of you: you ask the person directly in front of you, and they do the same to the person ahead of them, until someone reaches the very first person in line who says “zero people are ahead of me.”\n- Each person then passes that number back down the line, adding one for every person between them and the start, until you get the total count right back to you.\n- That’s recursion: breaking a big, complicated problem into tiny, identical little problems, solving the tiniest base case first, then building the full answer back up step by step."}
